comments.value:
Also just look at this cropping guide that someone posted. I am sorry, but this is a total design nightmare. It is impossible to make images that neatly fit into all these situations.

Neither the bottom nor top edges are consistent, even the sizing and position of the profile picture varies.

Can we please get something a bit more design friendly? Less variations, more consistency across client and website (even if that means making the website images smaller, for example) and aligned edges?

Just to point out another thing. Many role-play focused groups/events use group banners on nameplates to indicate consent (e.g. yes/no scares for horror events), roles people play as and/or to indicate who is a Staff member in case help/moderation is required. If banners become impossible to read/design due to these changes, then they essentially become a useless system.

The only alternative is to have some kind of indicator on your avatar but this would require to upload your own avatar which many people cannot do. While simply joining a group and representing said banner works for everyone.

Not to mention that an avatar can be hidden (e.g. for performance reasons) and then said alternative indicator would become completely useless. While a banner always remains visible one way or another and is much easier to read, especially from a distance.

To summarize:

Group banners on nameplates are not just simple decoration. They have a function which is utilized by many many different groups of all kinds and this change could severely impact said function if not completely ruin it. Leaving us with no real alternative and making hosting such events a nightmare.
@{62defacd09328244c0badc00|full_name} Really glad you raised these points, not something I considered but massively impacted in this case

@{62defacd09328244c0badc00|full_name} Thank you for saying this. Consent is critical for the functionality of so many groups and events. It’s necessary to differentiate spectators from participants, and to denote staff from everyone else. It’s a feature critical for the safety of members of these communities. Taking this feature away // diminishing it the way it is now is putting that safety at risk. Seriously, thank you for bringing this up!
Honestly this is a huge issue, its almost criminally bad how little space for banners there is now, theres literally no point to them anymore.
Yeah it's always been inconsistent and a nightmare to adjust, but the beta takes it to another level. Upvoted !

To give an example of what I mean. This is one of the banner we use for our group that indicates someone as a spectator using both the colour "orange" and text "Beast Observer" (in case we have someone who is colour blind). This is now barely visible with the menu closed and when opening the menu, all the icons and group name that have now been placed OVER the banner make it even harder to read or recognize anything.

As I already mentioned, this is a big issue and can lead to accidental misinterpretations of consent level and/or the represented role. Again, this makes hosting events that rely on banner systems like this a complete nightmare for both attendees and our moderation team.

I highly recommend that:

- The icons + group name to NOT be over the group banner (move them to above the nameplate for example)

- Give the banner more space and have it centered at all times instead of shifted up or down to make designing it easier but also ensure (in this case text or whatever you want to show off) is always visible

If the second is not wanted because otherwise the nameplate becomes too big, at least create an option in the settings where group banners can be deactivated or made smaller. But having them permanently this small defeats the purpose of having a group banner to begin with. Like why create one when no one is able to see it properly.

As another person who runs multiple group events with in VRchat the update to banners not only kills the ability to make staff easily visible in case of problems but it also is a major blow to any sort of roleplay style event that has been using banners for types of indicators, be it from what team someone is on to consent levels. 

This also just completely defeats the purpose of group banners hiding any relevant info from them.
this new name plate stuff sucks

details:
This is a bug report and a feature request. The new nameplate system completely trashes group banners, which didn't have a great standard (or any standard, for that matter), to begin with.

Currently, on live, a (mostly) consistent group banner means uploading a mostly transparent picture with the actual banner in the middle. This is wasting tons of space that could be actually used to show other art or graphics on the group page.

The image scales very poorly on some parts of the site, as well.

- Our uploaded group banner is 2000x1126, following this ***unofficial*** guide: https://www.reddit.com/r/VRchat/comments/10e11hb/groups_banner_guide/

- The [main group page](https://vrchat.com/home/group/grp_638f485d-f83d-4ae2-a559-63bcacb1faba) shows the original 2000x1126.

- A [group event page with no custom thumbnail](https://vrchat.com/home/group/grp_638f485d-f83d-4ae2-a559-63bcacb1faba/calendar/cal_fa8e4eef-4b43-4323-99cc-9cb1e28d8210) 1024x576

- The [groups landing page](https://vrchat.com/home/groups) scales the image to 256x144. This is extremely bad if you have made a banner with transparency, as per above.

- I'm sure there are many more exposed within the client itself and maybe other parts of the website. But I think this is a good demonstration of how wildly inconsistent this group feature is.

And now on beta with the new nameplate, we see just a few pixels of the group banner. This is effectively useless now for representing a visual of your group. I've attached a picture showing some of these inconsistencies.
title: [1878] Group Banners are useless with the new nameplates. Standardize group banner dimensions.
